notes.subject: ובאה השמש
notes.rationale: Hebrew lit. 'the sun shall come/enter upon the prophets' — 'set' vs 'come over (in darkness)'; I rendered 'na don … la' (come upon).

notes.subject: nabiw
notes.rationale: נביא rendered nabi per ruling; Bambara printed Bible's 'kira' is barred.

notes.subject: to the prophets
notes.rationale: Verse addresses the false prophets in second person 'aw' (lakhem), then shifts to third person.

notes.subject: לכם
notes.rationale: Second lakhem has no separate gloss; both 'unto you' phrases mark possession of night and darkness.

translation: O de sabu, su na tɔɔ aw la aw ma mahazɔn sɔrɔ, dibi na tɔɔ aw la aw ma se ka kɛsɛmɛ; tile na don nabiw la, don na kɛ dibi ye u kan.
